issueDetails: During the AGV integration deployment time, a few issues were observed in the mixer. In the PO confirmation process, when scanning the output one by one, the quantity should normally decrease; however, in this case, it was increasing unexpectedly. Due to this issue, PO confirmation could not be completed through MES. There was no production stoppage, and the machines continued to run without interruption. However, MES scanning was not functioning properly, and it took approximately 2 hours to analyze and resolve the issue
actionPlan: The root cause of the issue was that, for some materials, the value received from the Material Master was 0, which did not meet the criteria for expiry date handling in the AGV Interface. As a result, the team modified the code to handle both scenarios and ensure proper processing.

issueDetails: After restarting the Box PCs, even after completing the loading process on Plant-1 TBM BLD_F18 machine, the system did not allow access to the PO confirmation screen. A popup message stating “Previous process not completed” was displayed. Even in the NSNL OFF condition, the system did not allow PO confirmation. It took approximately 1.3 hours to analyze and rectify this issue. However, there was no machine stoppage and no production loss during this period.
actionPlan: The root cause of this issue was that, after a server restart, the MQTT database crashed. The team restarted the MQTT service and resumed the original data flow. Due to this unexpected crash, the issue was reported.
